text:
William Karlsson played only 14 games last season, so this is his first real run in a while, and the scoresheet is unkind: three goals and five points in 18 games while playing 17.58 minutes a night. Look past the points and the problem is not him.

Vegas has scored 11.6 fewer goals than its chances deserve with Karlsson on the ice. That is one of the biggest gaps in the league, and it's the whole reason his points per 60 sit at 0.95, below even the bottom of his talent range. His own shooting is near normal (11.1 percent), and his chances are fine.

There are real questions too. His 5v5 impact is slightly negative relative to teammates, and at 33 his place in the lineup is being earned again. But he's still skating fast by NHL EDGE (93rd percentile top speed), and the Lady Byng and 2023 Cup winner kills penalties and plays the hard minutes. When the on-ice shooting turns, his points will follow; our projection has him around 35.
headline: Karlsson's linemates can't buy a goal
